Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) indicated for hypertension. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie (from drug_indication.efo_id), indication_label (from drug_indication.efo_term or mesh_heading), and max_phase_for_ind (from drug_indication.max_phase_for_ind). Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Filter drug_indication where efo_term or mesh_heading contains 'hypertension'. Join compound_structures on molregno (INNER JOIN) to provide canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind.
